hunks.baseline: This massive building, shaped like a giant pentagon, was practically impregnable.
hunks.sol: The massive pentagon-shaped building was practically impregnable.

hunks.baseline: More than a thousand guards, every one of them a high-ranking Hunter. The immense flows of mana surrounding the inside and outside of the building alone were enough to convey the Pentagon’s stature.
hunks.sol: A security force of some thousand guards, every one of them a high-ranking Hunter. Immense flows of mana surrounded the building inside and out. That alone told you what kind of place the Pentagon was.

hunks.baseline: Magic Johnson had just finished the authentication process. Seeing Team Leader Choi and me looking around with our eyes wide, he flashed us a knowing grin.
hunks.sol: Magic Johnson had just finished the authentication process. Seeing Team Leader Choi and me looking around wide-eyed, he gave us a knowing grin.

hunks.baseline: “Since it was first built during World War II, the Pentagon has only been attacked twice. The 9/11 terrorist attacks and the Great Cataclysm. You both know how those turned out.”
hunks.sol: “Since it was first built during World War II, the Pentagon has only been attacked twice. Once on 9/11, and once during the Great Cataclysm. You both know how those turned out.”

hunks.baseline: “That’s right. It was the second fiercest battle of my life. The first was obviously the Day of Victory. And both times, one person helped me narrowly escape death.”
hunks.sol: “That’s right. It was the second fiercest battle of my life. The first was the Day of Victory, of course. Both times, one person helped me escape with my life.”

hunks.baseline: Any person on Earth, not just an American, knew that fact.
hunks.sol: Everyone on Earth knew that story, American or not.

hunks.baseline: During the Great Cataclysm and afterward, only one person had ever been able to stop the demon who had descended upon this world—the Demon King Asmodeus.
hunks.sol: During the Great Cataclysm and afterward, only one person had been able to stop the demon who descended upon this world: the Demon King Asmodeus.

hunks.baseline: “Cheon Taemin. If your maternal grandfather—the man Americans called Sky—hadn’t been there, neither I nor this Pentagon would exist today.”
hunks.sol: “Cheon Taemin. If your maternal grandfather—the man Americans call Sky—hadn’t been there, neither I nor this Pentagon would exist today.”

hunks.baseline: Magic Johnson gazed at Team Leader Choi with distant eyes, as if remembering something, when a voice suddenly rang out.
hunks.sol: Magic Johnson was gazing at Team Leader Choi with distant eyes, as though remembering something, when a voice came out of nowhere.

hunks.baseline: “I see you’re thinking the same thing as me, Johnson.”
hunks.sol: “I was thinking the same thing, Johnson.”

hunks.baseline: The owner of that voice was neither Team Leader Choi nor me. Naturally, it wasn’t the Skeleton King hiding inside my Inventory, either.
hunks.sol: It wasn’t Team Leader Choi or me. Naturally, it wasn’t the Skeleton King hiding in my Inventory, either.

hunks.baseline: Heavy footsteps approached.
The old white man wore wrinkled jeans and a shirt, and his white hair was thoroughly tangled and disheveled. One side of his elderly face was severely distorted.
hunks.sol: Heavy footsteps. Wrinkled jeans and a shirt. White hair tangled into a complete mess.

hunks.baseline: He strode toward us without hesitation and abruptly held out both hands.
hunks.sol: An elderly white man with one side of his face badly distorted strode up to us and thrust out both hands.

hunks.baseline: “I don’t know which of you two I should shake hands with first, so I’ll do both at once. I’m Chuck Hagel. You can just call me Chuck.”
hunks.sol: “I can’t decide which of you two to shake hands with first, so I’ll do both at once. Chuck Hagel. You can call me Chuck.”

hunks.baseline: His first greeting didn’t merely carry the air of a tough Texan. It overflowed with it.
hunks.sol: He didn’t just give off the air of a tough Texan. It practically poured out of him.

hunks.baseline: For some reason, Chuck Hagel’s face looked familiar. I stared at him as I took his hand.
hunks.sol: His face looked familiar. I stared at it as I took his hand.

hunks.baseline: “I’m Jin Taekyung. But, by any chance…”
hunks.sol: “I’m Jin Taekyung. But are you, by any chance…?”

hunks.baseline: “You’re wondering if I’m that Chuck Hagel? I am. I may not be as famous as you, but I used to cut down my fair share of monsters back in the day.”
hunks.sol: “That Chuck Hagel? Yep. I’m not as famous as you, but I cut down my fair share of monsters back in the day.”

hunks.baseline: I’d suspected as much just from looking at him, but the old man before me really was a previous-generation S-rank Hunter known as Uncle Chuck.
hunks.sol: I’d suspected it when I saw him, but the old man really was the previous generation’s S-rank Hunter known as Uncle Chuck.

hunks.baseline: I had never imagined I would meet one of the war heroes from the Great Cataclysm whom I had admired as a child. With a cry of delight, I vigorously shook his hand up and down.
hunks.sol: I’d never imagined I would meet one of the Great Cataclysm’s war heroes—the man I’d admired as a kid. I shook his hand vigorously.

hunks.baseline: “I’m a fan. A real fan. I even collected your Hunter cards when I was in elementary school.”
hunks.sol: “I’m a fan. A real fan. I even collected your Hunter cards in elementary school.”

hunks.baseline: “They probably sold them in North Korea, too. I bought them religiously whenever I got my allowance.”
hunks.sol: “They probably sold them in North Korea, too. I bought them every time I got my allowance.”

hunks.baseline: “Huh. So there was another stupid little brat here who gave me a fortune in royalties. Of course, I spent all the royalties I made back then on alimony from five divorces.”
hunks.sol: “Huh. So here’s another dumb little kid who handed me a fortune in royalties. Of course, I spent the lot on alimony from five divorces.”

hunks.baseline: Chuck Hagel smiled contentedly, instantly destroying one of my childhood memories.
hunks.sol: Chuck Hagel smiled contentedly, having demolished a childhood memory in a single sentence.

hunks.baseline: “If you still have any of my cards, bring them to me sometime. I’ll even sign them if you want.”
hunks.sol: “If you still have any of my cards, bring them by sometime. I’ll sign them if you want.”

hunks.baseline: “Ah, I traded all of them.”
hunks.sol: “Ah, I traded them all away.”

hunks.baseline: “After collecting ten, I traded them for a Cheon Taemin card a friend had. Honestly, Uncle Chuck cards weren’t all that rare.”
hunks.sol: “I collected ten and traded them for a Cheon Taemin card my friend had. Honestly, Uncle Chuck cards weren’t that rare.”

hunks.baseline: All traces of laughter vanished from Chuck Hagel’s face. He sighed.
hunks.sol: The smile vanished from Chuck Hagel’s face. He sighed.

hunks.baseline: “Damn it. And it wasn’t just anyone’s card. It was Mr. Sky’s. I can’t even say anything about that.”
hunks.sol: “Damn it. And of all people, it had to be Mr. Sky. Can’t argue with that.”

hunks.baseline: “There’s no comparison in rarity or value. My friend originally wanted twenty cards, but I haggled him down and down until…”
hunks.sol: “There’s no comparing their rarity or value. My friend wanted twenty cards at first, but I kept haggling until…”

hunks.baseline: “…I understand. I understand, so stop now.”
hunks.sol: “…I get it. I get it. You can stop now.”

hunks.baseline: Chuck Hagel shook his head repeatedly, then shook hands with Team Leader Choi.
hunks.sol: Chuck Hagel shook his head, then shook hands with Team Leader Choi.

hunks.baseline: “You look exactly like your maternal grandfather. Nice to meet you, Choi.”
hunks.sol: “You’re the spitting image of your maternal grandfather. Good to meet you, Choi.”

hunks.baseline: “Nice to meet you, Mr. Hagel.”
hunks.sol: “It’s a pleasure, Mr. Hagel.”

hunks.baseline: “I told you to call me Chuck. If you were one of those other idiots with nothing but shit in their heads, maybe not. But you and the traitor beside you have earned the right.”
hunks.sol: “I told you to call me Chuck. If you were one of those other idiots with nothing but shit in their heads, that would be different. But you and the traitor beside you have earned the right.”

hunks.baseline: *Look at him calling me a traitor just because I sold some cards.*
hunks.sol: *He’s calling me a traitor just because I traded his cards?*

hunks.baseline: While I grumbled inwardly, Team Leader Choi answered in a calm voice.
hunks.sol: As I grumbled to myself, Team Leader Choi replied calmly.

hunks.baseline: “Please understand, Mr. Hagel. I don’t feel comfortable addressing the person in charge of the Pentagon and the Secretary of Defense of the United States that way.”
hunks.sol: “Please understand, Mr. Hagel. I wouldn’t feel comfortable calling the man in charge of the Pentagon—and the United States Secretary of Defense—by his first name.”

hunks.baseline: “Hm. Is that so? Come to think of it, I suppose you do have to worry about what people think. You’re in charge of two massive Guilds now, after all.”
hunks.sol: “Hm. Is that so? I suppose you do have to consider how it would look. You’re in charge of two major Guilds now.”

hunks.baseline: I blinked as I listened to them.
hunks.sol: I blinked.

hunks.baseline: “The person in charge of the Pentagon? The Secretary of Defense?”
hunks.sol: “The man in charge of the Pentagon? The Secretary of Defense?”

hunks.baseline: “No, I didn’t. Obviously.”
hunks.sol: “Obviously not.”

hunks.baseline: “Really? Everyone else seemed to know. I assumed Johnson had at least told you.”
hunks.sol: “Really? Everyone else knows. I figured Johnson would’ve told you, at least.”

hunks.baseline: At the Secretary of Defense’s words, the Grand Mage—widely expected to be elected the next Secretary of Gukbap[^1]—scratched his chin.
hunks.sol: Under the Secretary of Defense’s gaze, the Grand Mage—widely expected to become the next Secretary of Gukbap[^1]—scratched his chin.

hunks.baseline: “I assumed you knew, too. Jin. You really didn’t know?”
hunks.sol: “I figured you knew, too. Jin, you really didn’t?”

hunks.baseline: At this point, I felt like I had somehow become an idiot. I replied with some reluctance.
hunks.sol: Now they were making me feel like an idiot. I answered awkwardly.

hunks.baseline: “I really didn’t know. Were you appointed a few days ago? Ah. That must be why I didn’t know.”
hunks.sol: “I really didn’t. Were you appointed a few days ago? Ah, that must be why I hadn’t heard.”

hunks.baseline: Chuck Hagel gave me a short, blunt answer.
hunks.sol: Chuck Hagel’s answer was short and blunt.

hunks.baseline: “Well, it’s not as if you particularly need to know. Compared to what we’re about to discuss, it isn’t especially important. Now, everyone, follow me.”
hunks.sol: “Well, you had no particular reason to know. It’s hardly important compared to what we’re about to discuss. Come on, everyone. Follow me.”

hunks.baseline: Chuck Hagel naturally pulled a cigar from the breast pocket of his dress uniform and put it between his lips. He took the lead, and we followed behind him.
hunks.sol: Chuck Hagel pulled a cigar from the breast pocket of his dress uniform and put it in his mouth as naturally as could be. He led the way, and we followed.

hunks.baseline: Every time Chuck Hagel puffed on his cigar, acrid smoke billowed up to the ceiling, setting off an alarm as red lights flashed.
hunks.sol: Each time he puffed on the cigar, acrid smoke rose to the ceiling. An alarm sounded, and a red light began to flash.

hunks.baseline: Without a moment’s hesitation, Chuck Hagel smashed the warning light and muttered,
hunks.sol: Chuck Hagel smashed the warning light without a moment’s hesitation.

hunks.baseline: He had gone beyond being a tough guy or a petty-minded bastard. He was simply insane.
hunks.sol: Forget tough guy. Forget petty bastard. This man was insane.

terminology_alerts.message: preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: The Skeleton King, who had safely passed through the security checkpoint while hiding in my Inventory, whispered,
hunks.sol: The Skeleton King, who had made it through the security checkpoint hidden in my Inventory, whispered,

hunks.baseline: “Is he even human? Not a monster?”
hunks.sol: “Is he human? Are you sure he isn’t a monster?”

hunks.baseline: I had plenty of doubts myself, but the man matched the description printed on the Hunter cards I had collected as a child.
hunks.sol: I had my doubts, too. But he matched the description on the Hunter cards I’d collected as a kid.

hunks.baseline: He was from Texas and had dreamed of becoming a cowboy. There were even unbelievable stories about him taming a minotaur with his bare fists and riding it around, among other things.
hunks.sol: Born in Texas. Dreamed of becoming a cowboy. Supposedly tamed a Minotaur with his fists and rode it around. And that was just the beginning.

hunks.baseline: No one was brave enough to stand in Chuck Hagel’s way as he marched forward without hesitation.
hunks.sol: No one was brave enough to stand in Chuck Hagel’s way.

hunks.baseline: Researchers, Hunters, and employees who appeared to belong to the Pentagon split to either side as if facing a disaster. Moses, who had a cigar in his mouth instead of a staff, crossed between them while spewing smoke like a chimney.
hunks.sol: Pentagon researchers, Hunters, and staff parted to either side as though a disaster were approaching. Moses, with a cigar instead of a staff, strode between them, spewing smoke like a chimney.

hunks.baseline: Of course, he didn’t forget to talk trash along the way.
hunks.sol: He didn’t forget to talk trash along the way.

hunks.baseline: “When is this damn hallway going to get wider? Every time I see it, I want to smash it to pieces.”
hunks.sol: “When the hell are they going to widen this damn hallway? Every time I see it, I want to smash it to pieces.”

hunks.baseline: “Hey, Smith. Put that electronic cigarette away while I’m asking nicely. If you waft that shitty strawberry scent in front of me one more time, I’ll put you on the list of people who died in the line of duty. Cigars are fine, though.”
hunks.sol: “Hey, Smith. Put that e-cigarette away while I’m asking nicely. Let me smell that shitty strawberry scent one more time, and I’ll put you on the list of people killed in the line of duty. Cigars are fine, though.”

hunks.baseline: “Gordon. A warning light was smashed in Section Three. Go fix it. Who broke it? Listen carefully. Your fucking direct superior.”
hunks.sol: “Gordon. There’s a smashed warning light in Section Three. Go fix it. Who broke it? Listen carefully: your fucking direct superior.”

hunks.baseline: No one could stop Chuck Hagel as he rampaged around like an enraged bull.
hunks.sol: No one could stop Chuck Hagel as he rampaged through the Pentagon like an enraged bull.

hunks.baseline: During the roughly five-minute walk, poor Smith was forced to change his e-cigarette liquid, innocent Gordon ran off with his feet on fire to repair the warning light, and seven more warning lights were smashed after they warned of the fire hazard caused by the clouds of cigar smoke.
hunks.sol: In the roughly five minutes it took us to reach our destination, poor Smith was forced to change his e-cigarette liquid, innocent Gordon ran off at full speed to repair the warning light, and seven more lights warning of a fire hazard met the same fate beneath the clouds of cigar smoke.

hunks.baseline: Gordon would probably have to repair those, too.
hunks.sol: Gordon would probably have to fix those, too.

hunks.baseline: This guy was seriously out of his mind.
hunks.sol: This guy really was out of his mind.

hunks.baseline: I was wondering who had come up with the insane idea of putting that man in the position of Secretary of Defense when Magic Johnson leaned toward me and whispered,
hunks.sol: I was wondering who’d had the insane idea of making him Secretary of Defense when Magic Johnson leaned over and whispered,

hunks.baseline: “Hey, guys. Chuck’s touchy because of the terrorist problem these days. He’s a good guy at heart, so try to understand him.”
hunks.sol: “Hey, guys. Chuck’s been touchy lately because of the terrorist problem. He’s a good guy at heart. Cut him some slack.”

hunks.baseline: “This goddamn hallway! Hallway! Hallway! Hallway! Didn’t I tell you to make the hallway wider?”
hunks.sol: “This goddamn hallway! Hallway! Hallway! Didn’t I tell you to make the hallway wider?”

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi stared blankly at the hallway as it widened, then asked with complete sincerity,
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi watched the hallway widen, then asked with complete sincerity,

hunks.baseline: “…Probably. Even if he looks like that, his abilities and drive as Secretary of Defense are second to none.”
hunks.sol: “…Probably. Whatever he looks like right now, he’s outstanding as Secretary of Defense. Capable, and he gets things done.”

hunks.baseline: Of course they were. Anyone who got even slightly on Chuck Hagel’s nerves would have their life ended.
hunks.sol: Of course he got things done. Get even slightly on Chuck Hagel’s nerves, and your life would be over.

hunks.baseline: Along with Magic Johnson’s suddenly much less confident answer, Chuck Hagel passed through a mana-recognition device and pointed toward a firmly closed door.
hunks.sol: As Magic Johnson’s answer trailed off with noticeably less confidence, Chuck Hagel passed through a mana-recognition device and pointed to a tightly shut door.

hunks.baseline: “We’re here already. Now, everyone. This is Building Five.”
hunks.sol: “We’re here already. Everyone, this is Building Five.”

hunks.baseline: “It’s called the E-Ring. And, for what it’s worth, as far as I know, this is the first time a foreigner has entered this place in twenty-five years.”
hunks.sol: “Also called the E-Ring. And for what it’s worth, as far as I know, no foreigner has set foot in here for twenty-five years.”

hunks.baseline: Chuck Hagel looked at Team Leader Choi and added with a grin,
hunks.sol: Chuck Hagel looked at Team Leader Choi and grinned.

hunks.baseline: “There was only one outsider on Earth who could freely come and go here. Mr. Sky. He was treated the same way as the President of the United States.”
hunks.sol: “Only one outsider on Earth was ever free to come and go as he pleased. Mr. Sky. He was treated the same as the President of the United States.”

hunks.baseline: Even setting aside everything else, Cheon Taemin’s status was proven by the fact that Chuck Hagel—of all people—referred to him as “Mister Sky” every single time.
hunks.sol: Even without the rest, the fact that *Chuck Hagel* unfailingly called him “Mr. Sky” said plenty about Cheon Taemin’s standing.

hunks.baseline: The instant Chuck Hagel finished speaking, brilliant light poured out from the entire surface of the door.
hunks.sol: The instant Chuck Hagel finished speaking, brilliant light poured from the entire door.

hunks.baseline: No. This wasn’t light. It was magic.
hunks.sol: No. It wasn’t light. It was magic.

hunks.baseline: I accepted the flow of mana sweeping over my entire body instead of resisting it.
Along with the dazzling light filling my vision, the space around us warped.
hunks.sol: I let the flow of mana sweep over my whole body without resisting it. Dazzling brightness filled my vision, and the space around us warped.

hunks.baseline: The moment I realized that this familiar sensation was Teleport, I blinked and found myself in a completely unfamiliar new space.
hunks.sol: I recognized the familiar sensation as Teleport. I blinked, and suddenly I was somewhere entirely new.

hunks.baseline: As my vision rapidly returned, I saw people seated around a pentagonal table.
hunks.sol: As my vision cleared, I saw people seated around a pentagonal table.

hunks.baseline: “Then the forces being deployed to the Middle East front will be… Oh. It seems our guests have finally arrived.”
hunks.sol: “Then the forces we’ll deploy to the Middle East front will be… Ah. Our guests have finally arrived.”

hunks.baseline: With a mechanical sound, the hologram illuminating the dark conference room vanished. A neat-looking middle-aged man seated at the head of the table stopped speaking and rose from his seat.
hunks.sol: With a mechanical chime, the hologram illuminating the dark conference room disappeared. A neat-looking middle-aged man at the head of the table stopped speaking and rose.

hunks.baseline: His face was more than familiar.
hunks.sol: I knew his face at once.

hunks.baseline: He was a man whose position kept him constantly exposed in every form of media. He looked older than he had on television and radiated even more charisma than he had in the newspapers.
hunks.sol: His position put him on every kind of screen day in and day out. He looked older than he did on TV and had even more presence than the newspapers conveyed.

hunks.baseline: At the middle-aged man’s amused remark, Chuck Hagel snapped off the glowing end of his cigar with his fingers and answered,
hunks.sol: At the man’s amused remark, Chuck Hagel snapped the glowing tip off his cigar with his fingers.

hunks.baseline: “They can deduct it from my salary.”
hunks.sol: “Take it out of my salary.”

hunks.baseline: “The Secretary of the Treasury asked me to tell you that, as it happens, your entire salary for this month has already gone toward repairing the Pentagon damage you caused.”
hunks.sol: “The Treasury Secretary asked me to pass on a message. Your entire salary for this month has already gone toward repairing the damage you’ve done to the Pentagon.”

hunks.baseline: “Damn it. Again? At this rate, I’ll be too afraid of alimony to get divorced.”
hunks.sol: “Damn it. Again? At this rate, I won’t be able to afford another divorce.”

hunks.baseline: Chuck Hagel let out a sighing mutter, then turned toward us.
hunks.sol: Chuck Hagel sighed and turned toward us.

hunks.baseline: “I suppose introductions aren’t necessary?”
hunks.sol: “No need for introductions, I assume?”

hunks.baseline: At least this time, they weren’t.
hunks.sol: This time, there wasn’t.

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi knew who the middle-aged man was. So did I. Even the Skeleton King knew.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi knew who the man was. So did I. Even the Skeleton King knew.

hunks.baseline: “Wicked human. Could that old human perhaps be…”
hunks.sol: “Wicked human. Is that old human perhaps…?”

hunks.baseline: That was right.
I gave a small nod. As the middle-aged man approached with measured steps, I murmured his name in my head.
hunks.sol: That was right. I gave a small nod as the middle-aged man approached with measured steps, and murmured his name to myself.

hunks.baseline: His title was more famous than his name.
He was the President of the United States.
hunks.sol: His title was better known than his name: President of the United States.

hunks.baseline: [^1]: *Gukbap* is rice served in hot soup. Jin is deliberately replacing *bang* (“defense”) in *gukbang-bu-jang-gwan*, “Secretary of National Defense,” with *bap*, creating the nonsensical title “Secretary of Gukbap.”
hunks.sol: [^1]: *Gukbap* is rice served in hot soup. Jin swaps *bap* (“rice”) into the Korean title for Secretary of Defense, turning it into the nonsensical “Secretary of Gukbap.”
